_note: Per-subject image orientation (2026-09-12: V04 was acquired with a CORONAL slab, the other three transversal; the phyllotaxis 'SI' self-navigation spoke runs along image axis 2 = the slab normal, i.e. AP for V04). Decided from the R0/REF images (scripts/orient_views.py, figures/orient_check_4subjects.png) and the twix headers.

V07.axis0: patient right -> left (the liver lies at low axis0 in the coronal slices)
V07.axis1: posterior -> anterior (spine at low axis1, sternum and anterior chest wall at high axis1)
V07.axis2: superior -> inferior (great vessels leave the heart towards low axis2; liver dome and upper abdomen at high axis2)
V07.note: Axis 2 is the SI axis, as expected from the self-navigation spoke along trajectory z, but the head is at the LOW index (the plan's template assumed high). Transverse slices (axis2 fixed) show heart, lungs, spine and descending aorta; coronal and sagittal slices show the liver above the heart in array order. The tissue fraction of transverse slices rises from 0.38 at axis2=16 to 0.84 at axis2=88 (lung -> upper abdomen). Relative to LPS only the y and z directions flip, i.e. a rotation, not a mirror.
